evidence.title: README (segment 1)
evidence.excerpt: The Railway CLI lets you interact with your Railway projects from the command line. Read the [CLI documentation](https://docs.railway.com/cli).

evidence.title: README (segment 2)
evidence.excerpt: Install the Railway CLI with agent support configured in one step (macOS, Linux, Windows via [WSL](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/windows/wsl/install)):

evidence.title: README (segment 3)
evidence.excerpt: This installs the CLI to `~/.railway/bin` and runs [`railway setup agent`](https://docs.railway.com/cli/setup) to configure detected agent tools.

evidence.title: README (segment 4)
evidence.excerpt: Other installation methods are available in the CLI documentation: [Homebrew](https://docs.railway.com/cli#homebrew-macos), [npm](https://docs.railway.com/cli#npm-macos-linux-windows), [Scoop](https://docs.railway.com/cli#scoop-windows), [pre-built binaries](https://docs.railway.com/cli#pre-built-binaries), and [source builds](https://docs.railway.com/cli#from-source).
